Sam (CS): hey all, starting CS week — need HubSpot support seat, Dialpad softphone + softphone number, and access to the trimmed playbook for quick handoffs. who's the quickest to approve? cc @Lena
Lena (Sales): welcome Sam! :tada: i'll share the account notes. for seats ping Priya in IT. for Dialpad we usually request a direct number if you'll be doing outbound onboarding calls.
Sam (CS): thanks. does CS get view-only of Deals or full deal edit? don't want to block notes.
Priya (IT): hi Sam — default is Support (contact/ticket write). deal-edit is downstream and requires a support_plus justification. fastest path: open a ticket or run the slash request. example command:
```
/seat-request product=hubspot role=support_user user=sam@redwood.ai reason="CS onboarding — needs contact edit & notes"
```
Dialpad request: 
```
/seat-request product=dialpad seat=softphone user=sam@redwood.ai request_number=true location=nyc
```
If you need a headset, add hardware=true and Omar will route.
Sam (CS): perfect. also want Gong listen for demo recordings and the CS short-playbook (one-pager).
Omar (Ops): the one-pager's here: https://drive.redwood.ai/CS/one-pager-handoff.pdf — has the intro email templates and a short escalation matrix. add "Gong Listen" to the ticket and include folder "CS Onboard" if you want access to recordings.
Lena (Sales): i'll DM you the Gong sequence id and the demo snippets; pro tip — use the "CS - Quick Intro" snippet for the first outreach.
Sam (CS): can someone paste the starter email for initial outreach? want to get it into Gong now.
Rhea (CS Manager): pasting short template — customize timing:

"Hi {{first_name}},

I'm Sam from Redwood Customer Success. I'll be your primary contact as we get you set up. Do you have a preferred time for a 30-minute setup call this week? If you'd like, I can share step-by-step integration notes ahead of time.

Best,
Sam"

Sam (CS): thanks Rhea — i'll slot that into Gong. curious: who owns follow-ups for trial customers after day 7?
Lena (Sales): Sales seeds the campaign, CS owns week0/week1 checks post-handoff. if a renewal conversation appears, tag sales-engage.
Sam (CS): quick setup question: will I get Zapier/GDPR notes for data-sharing or is that blocked?
Priya (IT): you get the integration docs link; for admin-level exports we need a data request ticket. for basic Zapier flows you can reference Confluence.
Omar (Ops): created Ticket #4820 for Sam: HubSpot (support_user), Dialpad (softphone + number), Gong Listen. ETA 1 business day.
welcome-bot: Welcome Sam! Onboarding checklist assigned — please complete the security training and sign the data handling form.
Sam (CS): great, i'll wait for the ticket update and book a 20-min sync with Lena to walk the handoff accounts. i'm free 14:00-15:30 ET tomorrow.
Lena (Sales): 14:30 ET works, invite sent. i'll bring account priority flags and two demo recordings.
Rhea (CS Manager): i'll join the sync to review the escalation matrix and first-week tasks. welcome aboard :raised_hands:
